title: Wasmer (YC S19) Is Hiring OS/Hypervisor Experts in Europe
summary: Wasmer, a Y Combinator S19 startup, is hiring operating system and hypervisor experts in Europe. The posting appears to focus on building low-level systems expertise, likely connected to Wasmer's WebAssembly runtime technology, but the provided content contains limited job details.
problem_solved: Wasmer is seeking specialized OS and hypervisor expertise to advance its systems and runtime infrastructure.
why_valuable: OS and hypervisor specialists are crucial for improving runtime performance, isolation, compatibility, and deployment across complex computing environments.
